eyebrow.zh: 失败方案台账 · 本地运行 · 一个 JSONL 文件
eyebrow.en: A tombstone ledger for failed approaches · local-only · one JSONL file

headline.zh: 别让 agent 把失败的路再走一遍。
headline.en: Stop agents from re-walking failed approaches.

sub.zh: deadend-ledger 把失败尝试写成带失败测试证据的墓碑,在相似任务开始时自动注入,让编程智能体第一眼就知道哪些路走不通。
sub.en: deadend-ledger records failed attempts as tombstones with failing-test evidence and injects them when similar work starts, so the coding agent sees the dead end before it starts walking.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系;实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: 每枚墓碑必须带可机器验证的证据:失败测试命令、错误定位或构建日志,随时可以重跑。
body.en: Every tombstone carries machine-checkable evidence: a failing test command, an error span or a build log you can re-run at any time.

body.zh: 会话开始时本地做 token 加权匹配,常量阈值;无 embedding、无网络、无守护进程,块长度硬上限,永远不会淹没上下文。
body.en: Session-start scoring is local token-overlap matching with a constant threshold: no embeddings, no network, no daemon, and a hard cap so injection can never flood context.

body.zh: 台账只收失败方案:没有事实、偏好和散文记忆。墓碑可以设置过期与复活条件,过期即停止注入。
body.en: The ledger holds failed approaches only — no facts, no preferences, no prose memory. Tombstones can expire and name a revive condition; past-due ones stop injecting.

body.zh: 在同一仓库反复开 agent 会话时,失败方案只存在于开发者的记忆里;换一个会话,agent 会把它当作新想法再走一遍。散文式记忆能复述失败,却不能在规划时排除它。deadend-ledger 引入墓碑这个记录类型:方案、作用域、机器证据、复活条件,一条 JSON 行一枚。
body.en: Across repeated agent sessions on one repo, failed approaches live only in the developer's memory; a fresh session treats them as new ideas. Prose memory can describe a failure but cannot exclude the option at planning time. deadend-ledger adds the missing record type — the tombstone: approach, scope, machine evidence and a revive condition, one JSON line each.

title.zh: 记录:六十秒写成一枚墓碑
title.en: Record: a tombstone in sixty seconds

body.zh: deadend record 接受完整 flags,也可以交互式提问;scope 默认取本仓库改动的文件,证据摘录自动截到 400 字符,每次写入都跑完整 schema 校验。
body.en: deadend record takes full flags or asks interactively; scope defaults to the files changed in this repo, the excerpt is capped at 400 chars, and every append passes full schema validation.

alt.zh: 记录、校验、会话开始时评分、命中注入或保持沉默的四个阶段。
alt.en: Four stages: record, validate, score at session start, inject on match or stay silent.

title.zh: 注入:开局一秒,规划上下文已带证据
title.en: Inject: evidence at the top of planning context

body.zh: SessionStart 与 UserPromptSubmit hook 运行 deadend inject:读 stdin 的任务上下文,与台账里的墓碑做确定性匹配,命中的按得分渲染成固定模版;无关任务零输出。
body.en: The SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hooks run deadend inject: read the task context from stdin, deterministically match it against the ledger, render hits into a fixed block by score; unrelated tasks emit nothing.

alt.zh: Claude Code hooks 到 inject、match、规划上下文的会话链路,以及 record 到校验、追加 JSONL 台账的记录链路。
alt.en: The session path from Claude Code hooks through inject and match to planning context, and the recording path from record through validation to the append-only JSONL ledger.

title.zh: 边界:v0.1 只做这一件事

body.zh: 只记负面结果,只接 Claude Code,只用 JSONL 台账,匹配不用 embedding。确定性匹配会因措辞漂移而漏配 —— 这是刻意选择:离线、免费、秒级,宁可漏配也不在每次会话开始时调用模型。
body.en: Negative results only, Claude Code only, JSONL only, no embeddings. Deterministic matching misses on wording drift — deliberately: instant, offline and free beats a model call at every session start.

alt.zh: 以 deadend 二进制为中心:两个 hook 事件、CLI 命令面、可提交的 JSONL 台账与设置合并。
alt.en: Around the deadend binary: two hook events, the CLI command surface, the committable JSONL ledger and the settings merge.

note.zh: 以下命令与输出来自 examples/fixture-demo.sh 的一次真实运行(夹具仓库、固定日期);inject 是确定性本地渲染,不涉及模型调用。
note.en: Commands and outputs below come from one real run of examples/fixture-demo.sh (fixture repo, pinned dates); inject is a deterministic local render, no model call.

body.zh: 创建 .deadend/ledger.jsonl,并把 SessionStart 与 UserPromptSubmit 两行 hook 合入 .claude/settings.json(先展示 diff,已有配置原样保留)。
body.en: Creates .deadend/ledger.jsonl and merges the SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hook lines into .claude/settings.json, showing the diff first.

body.zh: 磁盘缓存 access token 的方案在 CI 上因权限失败,记为 error_span 证据。
body.en: The on-disk token cache failed on locked-down CI runners; recorded with error_span evidence.

steps.command: deadend record --approach "cache access tokens on disk at ~/.authcache" ...
steps.output:
approach    cache access tokens on disk at ~/.authcache
scope       internal/auth/store.go
evidence    error_span | internal/auth/store.go:88: open ~/.authcache: permission denied (observed 2026-10-16)
excerpt     open ~/.authcache: permission denied — token cache write fails on locked-down CI runners
expires     never
revive when —

tombstone #1 recorded (ea1981dd) — the next matching session starts with it

body.zh: 把 JWT 库升到 v9 会拖动三个下游依赖,记为 build_log 证据。
body.en: Bumping the JWT library to v9 drags three downstream deps; recorded with build_log evidence.

steps.command: deadend record --approach "bump the JWT library to v9 to fix the refresh loop" ...
steps.output:
approach    bump the JWT library to v9 to fix the refresh loop
scope       go.mod, internal/auth
evidence    build_log | go build ./... (v9 requires module bump of 3 downstream deps) (observed 2026-10-17)
excerpt     github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v9: version 9.0.0 requires go >= 1.25; 3 downstream deps pin go 1.24
expires     never
revive when —

tombstone #2 recorded (97f93c1c) — the next matching session starts with it

body.zh: client-side token refresh 让 TestTokenRefresh 两次失败,从测试输出文件读取摘录并附上复活条件。
body.en: Client-side token refresh failed TestTokenRefresh twice; excerpt read from the test output, revive condition attached.

steps.command: deadend record --approach "use client-side token refresh" --scope internal/auth/token.go,TestTokenRefresh --kind failing_test --locator "go test ./internal/auth -run TestTokenRefresh" --file token-fail.txt --observed-at 2026-10-15 --revive-when "..."
steps.output:
approach    use client-side token refresh

evidence    failing_test | go test ./internal/auth -run TestTokenRefresh (observed 2026-10-15)
excerpt     --- FAIL: TestTokenRefresh (0.00s)
    token_test.go:11: refresh loop re-entered: token used to refresh itself,
        …
expires     never
revive when the auth backend accepts idempotent refresh (tracked as AUTH-214)

tombstone #3 recorded (2a8b91d0) — the next matching session starts with it

body.zh: show 渲染全部三枚墓碑及其证据定位符;定位符随时可以机器验证。
body.en: show renders all three tombstones with their machine-checkable evidence locators.

body.zh: 不在 scope 内的任务一个字节都不输出,wc -c 计数为 0;注入是确定性本地渲染,无模型调用、无网络。
body.en: A task outside the scope emits zero bytes (wc -c = 0); injection is a deterministic local render with no model call and no network.

steps.command: deadend inject --context "fix the flaky retry in the download queue" | wc -c

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。整个过程本地运行:不调用模型,不需要 API key,台账就是一个可提交的 JSONL 文件。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. Everything runs locally: no model calls, no API key; the ledger is one committable JSONL file.

steps.code:
deadend record
# 或全 flags:
deadend record --approach "use client-side token refresh" \
  --scope internal/auth/token.go,TestTokenRefresh \
  --kind failing_test \
  --locator "go test ./internal/auth -run TestTokenRefresh" \
  --file test-output.txt

deadend inject --context "try the client-side token refresh again"
deadend inject --context "unrelated task" | wc -c   # 0

limitations.zh: 确定性匹配会漏:任务措辞与 scope 键漂移过大时,墓碑不会注入。这是刻意取舍 —— 用离线秒级的漏配,换掉每次会话开始时的模型调用。
limitations.en: Deterministic matching misses: if task wording drifts far from the scope keys, the tombstone does not inject. Deliberate trade-off — an instant offline miss instead of a model call at every session start.

limitations.zh: v0.1 只接 Claude Code(SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hook);JSONL 台账格式与具体 agent 无关,其他集成属后续版本。review/revive 的状态流转尚未实现,deadend show 是当前的查看面。
limitations.en: v0.1 integrates Claude Code only (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks); the JSONL ledger format is agent-agnostic, other integrations are post-v0.1. Review/revive status transitions are not implemented yet; deadend show is the current review surface.

limitations.zh: 匹配只看 scope token,不读墓碑的 approach 文本;scope 建议用路径、符号、包名这类漂移小的键,而不是自由措辞。
limitations.en: Matching reads scope tokens only, not the approach wording; prefer drift-resistant scope keys (paths, symbols, packages) over free-form phrasing.
